description: Surface detail scans for the node renderer (src/render/detail-textures.ts). Each set is <name>_albedo.webp (sRGB colour; only its brightness relative to the mean is used) and <name>_rh.webp (R = roughness, G = height from the displacement map, normalized 0-1).
adaptation: 1k JPEG maps (Diffuse, Rough, Displacement) from Poly Haven, resized to 1024 px and re-encoded as WebP; means measured on the 1024 px images.

metal.author: Rob Tuytel
metal.use: bare metal on robots and vehicles; a light touch on paint

grain.author: Charlotte Baglioni
grain.use: tyres, bumpers and rough plastics, sampled at 0.6 m tiles

stucco.author: Dimitrios Savva
stucco.use: walls of homes and older buildings
